Description: This recall involves Fidlock Hermetic dry bags. The medium-sized, watertight plastic bags are clear and measure about 8 inches tall by 4.6 inches wide. They have a blue closure strip with magnets at the top and a black lanyard. “Fidlock” is printed in white on the front of the strip and lot number 2409140930201 is on the back. “Hermetic” is printed on the product packaging.
Title: Fidlock GmbH Recalls Hermetic Dry Bags Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion Hazard
ConsumerContact: Fidlock USA toll-free at 888-303-8332 from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET, Monday through Friday, email at recall_2608@fidlock.com, or online at www.fidlock.us/pages/recall or www.fidlock.us and click on “More Recall Information” for more information.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Sports, water sports and outdoor stores nationwide and online at Fidlock.us and Amazon.com from January 2025 through September 2026 for between $30 and $35.

Hazards.Name: The recalled bags’ adhesive closure strips can detach, causing the magnets to fall out, posing a risk of serious injury or death from a magnet ingestion hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the bags immediately and contact Fidlock USA to receive a replacement bag or a gift card for the Fidlock USA online shop. Customers who purchased the product from the FIDLOCK online store can receive a full refund in the form of a credit card refund or PayPal refund. Consumers will be asked to go to www.fidlock.us/pages/recall and send a photo of the product. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

Description: This recall involves the Cummins Onan P5000iDF EFI Dual Fuel Portable Generators sold in a dark gray color. The generators can operate on gasoline or propane, and produce between 4,500 and 5,000 watts, depending on fuel. “Cummins” is printed in white on the front of the unit and the handle above the control panel. The Cummins "C" logo and "Onan P5000iDF EFI" are printed on the side. The model and part number can be found on the label attached to the side of the generator.
Title: Cummins Recalls Portable Generators Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards
ConsumerContact: Cummins at 800-286-6467 Monday through Friday anytime or online at www.cummins.com/en-na/na/generators/portable-generators/safety-recalls/campaigns/7308 or go to www.cummins.com/en-na/na/generators/portable-generators and click on “Safety Recalls” at the top of the page for more information.

Products.Name: Cummins Onan P5000iDF EFI Dual Fuel Portable Generators

Images.Caption: Recalled Cummins Onan P5000iDF EFI Dual Fuel Portable Generator
Label on the side of the generator with the model and part number

Injuries.Name: The firm has received eleven reports of fuel discharging from the unit and the fuel cap ejecting unexpectedly, including one consumer reporting being splashed in the face with fuel. No medical attention was needed.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Camping World, Factory Pure, Northern Tool, AP Electric stores and online atCummins.com from May 2025 through August 2026 for between $1,640 and $1,930.

Hazards.Name: The valves in the recalled generators were installed incorrectly, preventing fuel vapors from venting properly from the gasoline tank, causing excessive pressure to build up. This pressure can cause fuel to discharge or the fuel cap to eject, posing a risk of serious injury from fire and burn hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled portable generators immediately and go to https://www.cummins.com/en-na/na/generators/portable-generators/safety-recalls/campaigns/7308 to check if the model and part number is included in the recall.  If your unit is affected, contact an authorized Cummins service location and arrange for a free repair at the service location. To find a service location near you, please use the Service Locator link at https://quickserve.cummins.com.

Description: This recall involves QIOMALA-branded pressure washers with model number “HWT12P”. The 1.2 GPM electric pressure washers were sold in green with black and in blue with black and measure about 14 inches deep, 11 inches wide and 15 inches high. The pressure washers came with a 500 ml soap tank, four quick disconnect nozzles and a 20-foot hose. Model number “HWT12P” is printed on a label on back of the unit, near the power cord entry point.
Title: QIOMALA Pressure Washers Recalled Due to Serious Risk of Injury or Death from Shock and Electrocution Hazards

Images.Caption: Recalled QIOMALA electric pressure washer-model HWT12P (green)
Recalled QIOMALA electric pressure washer-model HWT12P (blue)
Model number "HWT12P" shown on a label located on back of the recalled product

Retailers.Name:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.comfrom April 2026through June 2026 for about $130.

Importers.Name: Ningbo Miyao E-Commerce Co., dba QIOMALA, of China

Hazards.Name: The recalled pressure washers lack an adequate-length power cord, which can encourage use of an extension cord, posing a serious risk of injury or death from shock and electrocution hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled pressure washers immediately and contact QIOMALA for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to unplug the pressure washer, cut the power cord in half and send a photo of the destroyed power washer, showing the model number, to QIOMALA@163.com. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed recalled product.

Description: This recall involves lithium-ion rechargeable battery packs intended for use with Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker Systems. The serial number of the battery packs included in this recall begins with any one of the following six digits: 083723, 078352, 084105, 078591, 078592, 084106, or 086409.  The 17-digit serial number for the battery pack is printed on a label placed at the bottom of the battery pack. The affected battery packs were sold with S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker Systems and sold separately as accessories or replacement parts.
Title: Bose Recalls Lithium-Ion Battery Packs for S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Bluetooth Speaker Systems Due to Risk of Injury from Fire and Overheating Hazards
ConsumerContact: Bose toll-free at 800-278-1083 from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. ET Monday through Friday and 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Saturday or online at www.support.bose.com/s1-battery-recall or at www.bose.com and click on “Product Recalls” at the bottom of the page for more information.

Products.Name: Bose S1 Pro System Battery Pack and S1 Pro+ System Battery Packs for use with Bose S1 Pro and Bose S1 Pro+ Speaker Systems.
Products.NumberOfUnits: About 634,759 (In addition, about 35,400 were sold in Canada)

Images.Caption: Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker Systems (back and front)
Recalled Bose S1 Pro Portble Bluetooth Speaker System Battery Pack
Recalled Bose S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker System Battery Pack
Location of Serial Number on Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ System Battery Pack

Injuries.Name: The firm has received seven reports of the battery packs melting, producing smoke or catching fire, including six reports of property damage. No injuries have been reported.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Bose, Best Buy and other retail stores and distributors nationwide and online at Amazon.com, Bose.com, BestBuy.com, Walmart.com and other websites from December 2017 through July 2026 for between $100 and $160 for the individual battery packs. The speaker systems were sold with the battery packs for $700.

Hazards.Name: The recalled lithium-ion battery packs can overheat and ignite, posing a risk of injury from fire and overheating hazards.

Remedies.Name:
Consumers should remove the recalled battery packs installed in any S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker Systems and stop using the battery packs immediately. Once the battery pack is removed, consumers may continue to use their S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speakers while connected to AC power. Consumers will be asked to register and provide the affected battery pack’s serial number at www.support.bose.com/s1-battery-recall to receive a free replacement battery pack. For battery packs that are not installed in the speaker systems, consumers can simply view the serial number and provide that number to the website listed above. Consumers should dispose of the affected battery pack in accordance with local and state regulations. 

Note: Do not throw this recalled lithium-ion battery pack in the trash, the general recycling stream (e.g., street-level or curbside recycling bins), or used battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. Recalled lithium-ion batteries must be disposed of differently than other batteries because they present a greater risk of fire. Your municipal household hazardous waste (HHW) collection center may accept this recalled lithium-ion battery pack for disposal. Before taking your battery pack to a HHW collection center, contact that office ahead of time and ask whether it accepts recalled lithium-ion batteries. If it does not, contact your municipality for further guidance.

Description: This recall involves Bodum 8-cup and 12-cup Bistro, Brazil, Caffettiera, Chambord, Crema, Java, Jesper, and Kenya model French Press coffee makers with replaceable glass carafes. The Bodum name appears on the frame and inner lid of most models, and is engraved, along with product warnings, on the glass carafes. Additional photos and model-identifying information are available on the recall website.
Title: Bodum USA Recalls 5.9 Million French Press Coffee Makers with Replaceable Glass Carafes Due to Risk of Serious Burn Injury
ConsumerContact: Bodum USA toll-free at 888-879-8213 from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at Bodum3302@sedgwick.com, or online at www.bodumfrenchpressrecall.expertinquiry.com or www.bodum.com  and click on “Recall Information” for more information.

Products.Name: Bodum French Press coffee makers with 8-cup and 12-cup replaceable glass carafes (Bistro, Brazil, Caffettiera, Chambord, Crema, Java, Jesper, and Kenya models)

Images.Caption: Identifying text on Bodum French Press Carafe

Injuries.Name: Bodum USA has identified 70 reports of carafes breaking during use, including 48 reports of burns to consumers

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Target, Walmart, and coffee and home goods stores nationwide and online at Bodum.com, Amazon.com, Target.com, Walmart.com and other online retailers from 1974 through October 2026 for about $15 to $65.

Importers.Name: Bodum USA, Inc., of New York, New York

Hazards.Name: The carafe can unexpectedly break during use if the glass carafe is damaged or cracked, including by use of a metal spoon to stir the coffee, posing a risk of serious burn injuries.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using metal spoons or utensils to stir coffee in the glass carafe immediately and contact Bodum to receive a plastic Bodum stirring spoon and warning label. The label reminds consumers not to use cracked or damaged carafes and not to use metal spoons to stir contents in the glass carafe in order to avoid damaging the glass, which can lead to breakage during use.

Description: This recall involves DREO space heaters, model number DR-HSH015. The ceramic, electric heaters are black and measure about 11.5 inches wide and 13 inches tall and include a remote control. Only units manufactured from April 2025 through January 2026 are included in this recall. The manufacture date, in YYYY/MM format, and the model number are printed on a label on the heater’s underside and “DREO” on the front of the unit.
Title: DREO Recalls DR-HSH015 Space Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
ConsumerContact: DREO toll-free at 833-820-0887 from 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, by email at spaceheater@realtimeresults.net, or online at www.dreo.com and click on “PRODUCT RECALLS” on the top of the page, or www.recallrtr.com/spaceheater for more information.

Products.Name: DREO Space Heaters, model DR-HSH015
Products.NumberOfUnits: About 338,800 (In addition, about 36,300 were sold in Canada)

Images.Caption: Recalled DREO Space Heater - model DR-HSH015
The manufacture date, in YYYY/MM format, and model "DR-HSH015" are printed on a label on the underside of the recalled DREO space heaters

Injuries.Name: DREO has received 17 reports of space heaters igniting, three resulting in property damage and one in a burn injury to the hand.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Costco stores nationwide and online at Dreo.com, BestBuy.com, Kohls.com, Lowes.com, QVC.com, HomeDepot.com, B2BRenew.com and Costco.com from September 2025 through October 2026 for between $70 and $110.

Importers.Name: Hesung Innovation Corp, dba DREO, of Clifton, New Jerse

Hazards.Name: The recalled space heaters can overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled space heaters immediately and contact DREO for a free replacement space heater. Consumers will be asked to unplug the space heater, destroy it by cutting the electrical cord and follow instructions to send a photo of the destroyed heater.

Description: This recall involves NTI brand residential gas boilers in the FTVN and TFTN model series, and HTP brand residential gas boilers in the EFTU model series. The NTI FTVN and TFTN series boilers are gray, while the HTP EFTU (Elite Fire Tube Ultra) boilers are black. The boilers are metal, rectangular units and have either NTI or HTP printed on the front. The model serial number can be found on the rating plate, located on the left-hand side of the boiler. The following models and serial number ranges are included in this recall:
Title: NTI and HTP Brand Gas Boilers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire, Carbon Monoxide (CO) Poisoning and Impact Hazards; Manufactured by Ariston, formerly NTI Boilers
ConsumerContact: Ariston at 800-688-2575 from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at VCexchanger@ariston.com or online at https://ntiboilers.com/safety-recalls or www.ntiboilers.com and click on “RECALLS” at the top of the page or https://htproducts.com/safety-notice.html or www.htproducts.com and click on “URGENT RECALL” at the top of the page for more information.

Products.Name: NTI and HTP residential gas boilers

Images.Caption: Recalled NTI and HTP Brand Gas Boilers

Injuries.Name: The firm has received 34 reported incidents of the condensate dish breaking, including three reports of the front cover detaching from the boiler. In one reported incident the technician servicing the boiler sustained a broken jaw.

Manufacturers.Name: Ariston Canada Inc. (Formerly NTI Boilers Inc.), of Canada

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Independent heating and plumbing contractors and wholesale distributors nationwide from May 2021 through July 2026 for between $3,200 and $7,700.

Importers.Name: Ariston Thermo USA LLC, of Providence, Rhode Island

Hazards.Name: The condensate dish inside the boiler can crack during a delayed ignition, allowing unburned gas to build up inside the sealed cabinet. If the gas ignites, the front cover can suddenly detach, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire, carbon monoxide (CO) poisoning, and impact hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled boilers immediately and contact Ariston to schedule a free repair by a certified technician. Consumers who must continue using the boiler while awaiting repair should have working smoke and carbon monoxide alarms in their homes.
